newsitem.title: UK: Spinner enquiry slow in European raw cotton market.
newsitem.headline: Spinner enquiry slow in European raw cotton market.

text.p: Fresh spinner enquiry for raw cotton was slow to emerge in most European markets, industry sources said.

But a somewhat better tone was in evidence in Portugal, Italy and Belgium with attention centring principally on competitively priced nearby shipment offers of Central Asian and Middle Eastern medium/better qualities.

The markets in Eastern Europe were generally lacking in feature and the only interest in evidence for long staple varieites was tentative and directed mainly to late winter shipment offers of American Pima, the sources said.
